verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is a programmatic Python library and a self-hosted proxy with a documented official CLI (worker-process flags) and a Docker image, so it can run headlessly for automation. MCP tools can also be called with curl without an LLM. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage guidance (e.g., CI pipeline examples), non-interactive config/auth guidance for automation, independent hands-on corroboration of CI runs.
